letters.title: Dear UKT,
paragraphs: Pata nahi dosti ko words mein perfectly explain karna possible hai ya nahi, but kuch log aise hote hain jo life mein aakar ordinary moments ko bhi special bana dete hain.

Tumhare saath bitaye hue moments shayad dusron ke liye normal hon, but mere liye unmein ek alag hi feeling hai — random baatein, hasi-mazaak, chhoti-chhoti memories aur woh moments jo bina plan kiye yaadgaar ban gaye.
Thank you for being one of those people.
I hope life tumhe bahut saari happiness de, tumhare saare dreams poore ho, aur chahe time kitna bhi change ho, hamari ye chhoti si friendship aur ye memories hamesha special rahein.
Photos toh bahut hain, par memories unse bhi zyada hain. ❤️
letters.author: Your friend ♡
